memberdef.name: ProcessMI

briefdescription.para: runOnMachineFunction - This method must be overloaded to perform the desired machine code transformation or analysis.
This Pass first walks through all the MOVEM instructions that are chained together and record each of the instruction's properties like register mask and data access type into a MOVEState instance.

detaileddescription.para: Then we perform reduction / collapsing on this MOVEMState representation before creating a new MOVEM instruction based on the collapsed result, as well as removing redundant MOVEM instructions.
